title: Evaluation of automated driving system safety metrics with logged vehicle trajectory data
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation and comparison of real-time safety metrics for automated driving systems, specifically regarding collision avoidance and prediction performance. While 'safety' is a core theme, it is approached from an engineering and statistical performance perspective (e.g., recall, precision, false positives), not from a philosophical, moral, or ethical standpoint related to religion or faith. The brief mention of 'Responsibility-Sensitive Safety' refers to a technical model, not a discussion of ethical principles beyond the scope of vehicle behavior rules.
